message:
Command `cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3157,"var":"c","code":"if (c != 3 && c != 1 && c != 4) return stbi__err(\"bad component count\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The crafted file uses a supported 4-component JPEG, enabling the decoder to enter the CMYK resampling path."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3173,"var":"z->img_comp[i].h","code":"z->img_comp[i].h = (q >> 4);  if (!z->img_comp[i].h || z->img_comp[i].h > 4) return stbi__err(\"bad H\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The attacker-controlled SOF factor is accepted as long as it falls within 1..4, even if the combination is noncanonical."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3212,"var":"z->img_comp[i].raw_data","code":"z->img_comp[i].raw_data = stbi__malloc_mad2(z->img_comp[i].w2, z->img_comp[i].h2, 15);","note":"The component storage is allocated from the crafted dimensions, so later upsampling and scan reconstruction operate on attacker-shaped buffers."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3759,"var":"r->hs","code":"r->hs      = z->img_h_max / z->img_comp[k].h;","note":"The malformed component factors are converted to integer expansion ratios, creating the fractional-subsampling mismatch at the heart of the bug."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3770,"var":"r->resample","code":"else                               r->resample = stbi__resample_row_generic;","note":"The decoder falls back to generic resampling rather than rejecting the malformed JPEG geometry."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__resample_row_generic","line":3509,"var":"out[i*hs+j]","code":"out[i*hs+j] = in_near[i];","note":"The generic resampler writes output using the attacker-derived expansion factor, which can overrun the intended row extent when the component geometry is inconsistent."}
]
JSON
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.
